test_raw_ptr_derived_pass_cptr_base: test that a raw pointer derived instance can be passed as a base class raw pointer and returns the correct computed value
test_shared_ptr_derived_pass_shcp_base: test that a shared pointer derived instance can be passed as a base class shared pointer and returns the correct computed value
test_upcast_raw_ptr_derived_pass_cptr_de: test that a base class raw pointer return is down-cast to derived type and passed back as a derived raw pointer
test_upcast_shared_ptr_derived_pass_shcp: test that a base class shared pointer return is down-cast to derived type and passed back as a derived shared pointer
test_python_multiple_inheritance_derived: test that a Python class inheriting from two C++ base classes can be passed to functions expecting either base class pointer
